opt-blind-comparison.name: Blind comparison with one rubric
opt-blind-comparison.summary: Have one independent reviewer grade both masked variants against a shared rubric.
opt-blind-comparison.needed_when: An evaluation compares variants and requires subjective judgment.

opt-shared-premise-probe.name: Test the shared premise before another fix
opt-shared-premise-probe.summary: Check whether an assumption shared by failed fixes is true.
opt-shared-premise-probe.needed_when: At least two fixes share a known assumption and fail the same verification gate.

opt-formal-model-resync.name: Resync a formal model to covered code
opt-formal-model-resync.summary: Check that modeled transitions still match the implementation.
opt-formal-model-resync.needed_when: Code covered by an existing formal model has changed since its recorded sync.
